description: The Along Track Scanning Radiometer (ATSR-1) measured sea-surface temperatures using two viewing angles for atmospheric correction. Onboard reference targets provided stable radiometric calibration for climate observations.
facility_description: ERS-1 carried the first ATSR instrument, launched on 17 July 1991.
notes: ATSR project pages credit the Oxford, Met Office, UCL and Rutherford Appleton Laboratory consortium; these are historical contributor credits, not a requested acknowledgement. Filter-curve redistribution terms and calibration bibliography remain unresolved.
